summary: Iteration 3: Late Mark + Missed Punch request. Backend 14/14 pytest pass (TEST_ employee only). Frontend E2E (TEST_UI1 employee + admin) passed: late warning, punch dialog with fake camera + GPS checks, 30s countdown auto-submit, confirm-punch early submit, today-late-badge, missed punch form + server validation toasts, admin type filter 'Missed Punch', approve -> manual-punch-tag + late-badge + 8h 30m, stat-late-today. Run at ~23:40 IST using the temporary .env windows. No vendor sync triggered; all TEST_ employees deleted (cascade).

issues: fmtTime/clock use the browser's timezone, not Asia/Kolkata. If the browser is not on IST, a missed punch of 09:50 IST shows as 04:20 am. Pass timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata' to toLocaleTimeString/DateString.
Large late values show as raw minutes (e.g. 'Late 1419m'). Consider showing 'Late 23h 39m' or 'Late 9h 49m'.

action_items: IMPORTANT: revert backend/.env PUNCH_IN_WINDOW/PUNCH_OUT_WINDOW to production values (09:10-09:30 etc.) and restart backend
Optional: format times in the Asia/Kolkata timezone in the frontend
Optional: show large late values in hours and minutes
critical_code_review_comments: Missed-punch future date check works on the server; the client relies on the max={localDate()} attribute (browser local date), which is fine.
apply_missed_punch: if missed='in' is approved on a date that already has a punch_out (rare), late is recomputed but work_minutes stays correct. OK.
vendor_sync.push_attendance: late map and P/L/H codes look correct by code review only. It was NOT executed against the live portal, as instructed.
pytest config uses xdist + random order: run tests/test_late_missed_punch.py with '-n 0 -p no:randomly' because the tests depend on module fixtures and run in a fixed order.
seed_data_creation: TEST_L<tag> (pytest) and TEST_UI1 (UI) employees were created and deleted. No real employees were touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_late_missed_punch.py -n 0 -p no:randomly. The late tests assume the temporary windows (in 00:00-00:01). With production windows, test_config/test_late_punch_in will need adjusting.
